_comment: How the tutorial's Einsum labels map onto the IR, and the few facts the
labels: written Einsum -> position in the IR cascade, in running order. A
LIST means one written line lowered to several IR nodes. Four lines did:
E02  the depth extraction. floor(F/|R|) needs the quotient
materialised first, because UnaryApp.operand is typed
InputTensor and cannot wrap a division.
E11  a three-way product, and BinaryApp is binary.
so the same claim is an OR-reduction and a negation.
E17  the tutorial nests a reduction inside a product; the inner one
carries its own ReduceSpec and so is its own node.
E18  sigma(d*+1, r) mixes a tensor value with a coordinate, so the
depth part is computed before the coordinate is added.
The labels are what make a line in set_cover.md, a row in the builder
and a step in the visualiser refer to the same thing.
